name: sg-llm-response-inspector
description: Collapsible JSON browser for LLM response data. Listens for llm:request-complete events and displays: Summary (key fields), Images (inline preview), Chunks (raw SSE chunk-by-chunk navigation), Full Data (collapsible JSON tree). Compatible with OpenRouter, Anthropic, Ollama, OpenAI. Requires sg-llm-request v0.1.1+ for rawChunks/images/rawResponse fields.

listens: llm:request-complete — from sg-llm-request; uses detail.rawChunks, detail.images, detail.rawResponse, detail.model, detail.finishReason, detail.latencyMs, detail.promptTokens, detail.completionTokens

api.clear: Clear the current response data and reset to empty state
api.getData: Returns the last captured REQUEST_COMPLETE event detail, or null

tabs.summary: Key fields: model, finish_reason, latency, token counts, image count, chunk count
tabs.images: Inline image previews from detail.images[] — supports OpenAI image_url and Anthropic base64 formats
tabs.chunks: Raw SSE chunks with Prev/Next navigation — shows full parsed JSON per chunk
tabs.fulldata: Collapsible JSON tree of all response data with Expand All / Collapse All controls
